description: Modern standard species/form dimensions for all 503 roster slots (the scarred Zangoose shares ordinary Zangoose dimensions). Nearest-inch heights encoded as feet*100+inches; weight is tenths of a pound rounded from kg using 2.20462, matching the reversible battle conversion. Six custom species retain authored dimensions. Custom Bloodmoon Teddiursa/Ursaring and clone slots use their ordinary-species dimensions; Palafin uses Hero and Dudunsparce Two-Segment. Downloaded source hashes record the 2026-11-02 audit.

DIPPLIN.reason: PokeAPI incorrectly uses 9.7 kg (the pound value); official site confirms 4.4 kg.

URSALUNABM.reason: PokeAPI incorrectly repeats ordinary Ursaluna dimensions; official site confirms Bloodmoon dimensions, already correct in game.
